mapper.sql: select task_id, work_id, chapter_id, owner_user_id, content_hash, status, attempt_count, next_run_time, worker_id, lease_until, result_json, error_message, started_time, finished_time, create_by, create_time, update_time from ai_novel_context_task
mapper.insert: insert ignore into ai_novel_context_task (work_id, chapter_id, owner_user_id, content_hash, status, attempt_count, next_run_time, create_by, create_time, update_time) values (#{workId}, #{chapterId}, #{ownerUserId}, #{contentHash}, 'PENDING', 0, now(), #{createBy}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update ai_novel_context_task set status = 'PENDING', attempt_count = 0, next_run_time = now(), worker_id = null, lease_until = null, result_json = null, error_message = null, started_time = null, finished_time = null, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and status in ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'OBSOLETE')
mapper.select: select task_id from ai_novel_context_task where attempt_count < #{maxAttempts} and ((status = 'PENDING' and next_run_time <= now()) or (status = 'RUNNING' and lease_until < now())) order by task_id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update ai_novel_context_task set status = 'RUNNING', worker_id = #{workerId}, lease_until = date_add(now(), interval #{leaseSeconds} second), attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, started_time = coalesce(started_time, now()), update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and attempt_count < #{maxAttempts} and ((status = 'PENDING' and next_run_time <= now()) or (status = 'RUNNING' and lease_until < now()))

update ai_novel_context_task set status = 'SUCCEEDED', result_json = #{resultJson}, error_message = null, worker_id = null, lease_until = null, finished_time = now(), update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and status = 'RUNNING' and worker_id = #{workerId}

update ai_novel_context_task set status = 'OBSOLETE', error_message = #{errorMessage}, worker_id = null, lease_until = null, finished_time = now(), update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and status = 'RUNNING' and worker_id = #{workerId}

update ai_novel_context_task set status = 'PENDING', next_run_time = date_add(now(), interval #{retryDelaySeconds} second), error_message = #{errorMessage}, worker_id = null, lease_until = null, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and status = 'RUNNING' and worker_id = #{workerId}

update ai_novel_context_task set status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{errorMessage}, worker_id = null, lease_until = null, finished_time = now(), update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and status = 'RUNNING' and worker_id = #{workerId}

update ai_novel_context_task set status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{errorMessage}, worker_id = null, lease_until = null, finished_time = now(), update_time = now() where status = 'RUNNING' and lease_until < now() and attempt_count >= #{maxAttempts}

update ai_novel_context_task set status = 'OBSOLETE', error_message = #{errorMessage}, worker_id = null, lease_until = null, finished_time = now(), update_time = now() where chapter_id = #{chapterId} and status in ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
